content: [SYNTHETIC EDUCATIONAL CONTENT — NOT REAL MEDICAL ADVICE] Coronary artery disease is a long-term condition affecting the blood vessels that supply the heart. Family history — especially early heart disease in a parent — is one of several factors clinicians consider.

[SYNTHETIC EDUCATIONAL CONTENT — NOT REAL MEDICAL ADVICE] Chest pain or pressure, especially with arm pain, sweating, or breathlessness, can be a sign of a heart emergency. If that happens, seeking emergency care immediately is the safe course.

[SYNTHETIC EDUCATIONAL CONTENT — NOT REAL MEDICAL ADVICE] Not smoking, staying active, and regular check-ups that may include cholesterol are commonly discussed for heart health. A clinician tailors advice to the individual.
